payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the source-to-edit comparison establish that a frog has been placed within the toilet bowl?
node.criteria: First inspect the edited image independently for a recognizable frog situated within the bowl interior, using position relative to the opening, contact, and occlusion rather than mere overlap. Then compare that placement with the source image. Pass if the comparison establishes an added frog or a frog moved into the bowl. A newly recognizable frog added where an ambiguous source object was visible can establish completion; do not assume that the source object was already a frog or require its removal. Fail if the edited image clearly contains no frog within the bowl, or comparison clearly establishes that the only qualifying frog placement is unchanged and no requested placement occurred. Unknown if frog identity, interior placement, or the relevant source-to-edit correspondence cannot be resolved. Frogs solely on the lid, rim, or floor do not establish completion, but additional frogs outside the bowl do not negate a qualifying placement.
node.binding: Compare the supplied source and edited images of the same toilet. Preserve the requested placement inside the bowl. Require at least one qualifying frog, without adding requirements for exact count, realism, cleanup, removal of pre-existing objects, or absence of other frogs.
